production_rules: RAG retrieves grounded questions; it does not generate the primary question pool.
LangGraph selects and sequences retrieved questions, manages follow-ups, difficulty, coverage, and state.
LLM evaluation must award partial credit and separately list correct concepts, missing concepts, and misconceptions.
Embedding similarity is for retrieval/deduplication support, never the sole correctness judge.
Resume questions must use only verified resume/project evidence; never invent technologies or achievements.
A six-primary-question interview may include up to two adaptive follow-ups per primary question.
Before production, run semantic duplicate detection and human review of expanded variants.
